howToApply: Register on the Apprenticeship India web portal at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in for enrollment as an Apprentice and obtain a unique Registration Number (e.g., AXXXXXXXXXX).
Complete mandatory AADHAR (e-KYC) verification on the apprenticeshipindia.gov.in portal.
Visit IGCAR website www.igcar.gov.in under the ‘Opportunities -> Recruitment’ tab from 20/07/2026 to 19/08/2026.
Read the detailed advertisement and instructions carefully before filling the online application form.

Keep scanned documents ready in PDF format for uploading: (i) Caste/Disability/EWS Certificate, (ii) 8th/10th class marksheet, ITI Trade Certificate (NCVT/SCVT), semester-wise marksheets and consolidated marksheet as a single PDF.
Fill in all required personal details and trade details as per your certificates.
Submit the online application form. Note: Only one trade application per candidate is allowed.
After final submission, no changes/corrections will be entertained.
Candidates must have a valid and active personal e-mail ID and mobile number till completion of the selection process.

title: NPCIL Recruitment 2026 – Stipendiary Trainee, Technician (Postponed) Posts
shortInfo: NPCIL has announced notification for Stipendiary Trainee, Technician (Postponed) posts. Required qualification: SSC, ITI, HSC, ISC. Last date to apply: Update.

dates.event: Commencement of submission of online application (Update Soon)
Last date for submission of online application (Update Soon)

howToApply: Eligible applicants have to apply online on the website https://www.npcilcareers.co.in only.
The online registration will commence from 15.07.2026 at 10:00 hrs. and will close on 04.08.2026 at 16:00hrs.
It is mandatory to input all the relevant information such as qualification details, experience details, percentage of marks, contact mobile number, e-mail address, address for correspondence etc.

Before applying online, candidate should scan her/his recent passport size color photograph in JPG format, of size not more than 50KB and not less than 10KB and having a resolution not more than 640X480 (height X width) and not less than 240X180 (height X width).

Before applying online, candidate should scan her/his recent signature in JPG format, of size not more than 20KB and a minimum of 80 x 100 pixels (height x width) and a maximum of 160 x 560 pixels (height x width) in dimensions.
Candidate is requested to enter her/his valid and active email address, as all important communications will be sent to this email address only.

howToApply: Visit the official website: www.tnpscexams.in
Complete One Time Registration (OTR) by paying Rs.150/- registration fee (valid for 5 years). Link Aadhaar number with OTR (mandatory).
Upload scanned photograph (20KB–50KB, taken on or after date of notification) and signature (10KB–20KB).
Log in using your User ID and Password and click ‘APPLY’ against the notified post.
Fill in the online application with all required details including subject paper choice, community, disability, employment status, etc.
Upload all required supporting documents (educational qualifications, community certificate, age proof, eye fitness certificate where applicable, etc.).
Pay the examination fee of Rs.100/- per subject paper opted via Net Banking / Credit Card / Debit Card / UPI.
Preview the application and make corrections if needed before final submission.
Click ‘SUBMIT’ to finally submit the application. Note the Application Number for future reference.
Application Correction Window is available from 19.08.2026 (12:01 AM) to 21.08.2026 (11:59 PM) for editing submitted applications.
